bio.text: Sarah Trone Garriott, who represented West Des Moines in the Iowa Senate, announced in May 2025 that she would run as a Democrat for Iowa's 3rd Congressional District in 2026.
According to Iowa Capital Dispatch, she was first elected to the Iowa Legislature in 2020 to represent Senate District 22, and won Senate District 14 in 2022 and 2024.
Iowa Capital Dispatch described her as a Lutheran pastor.

sources.title: State Sen. Sarah Trone Garriott launches congressional campaign in Iowa's 3rd District
